test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 02 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the name of the herbal cream developed by CSIR-CIMAP for treating psoriasis released in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PsoriaCIM**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The herbal cream **PsoriaCIM** was developed by **CSIR-CIMAP (Central Institute of Medicinal and Aromatic Plants)**, a constituent laboratory of the **Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)** in India.
 
• This cream was specifically designed to treat **psoriasis**, which is a chronic autoimmune condition that affects the skin by causing inflammation, redness, and scaling.
 
• The cream incorporates **herbal formulations** that are natural and have been scientifically tested for efficacy in managing the symptoms of psoriasis.
 
• The launch of **PsoriaCIM** in **May 2025** marked a significant milestone in the use of herbal medicine for skin conditions.
 
• CSIR-CIMAP's innovation aligns with their mission to promote the use of **medicinal and aromatic plants** for therapeutic purposes. *Hence, PsoriaCIM was the correct answer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Psoriasis:**

 
 
• **Psoriasis** is a chronic autoimmune disorder that primarily affects the skin, causing itchy, scaly patches. It is a non-contagious condition but can significantly affect quality of life.
 
• The condition is characterized by an accelerated skin cell cycle, leading to the buildup of cells on the skin’s surface. This causes scaling, redness, and inflammation.
 
• While there is no permanent cure for psoriasis, treatments aim to manage symptoms and reduce inflammation.
 
 
 
• **CSIR-CIMAP:**
 
 
• The **Central Institute of Medicinal and Aromatic Plants (CIMAP)** is a frontier research laboratory of CSIR, based in **Lucknow, India**.
 
• CIMAP focuses on the development of novel products and technologies derived from **medicinal and aromatic plants**.
 
• It is well-known for its work in herbal and alternative medicine, which is aimed at addressing health and wellness challenges.
 
 
 
• **Other Options:**
 
 
• **Herbaloid:** This is a hypothetical name and not related to any herbal product for psoriasis.
 
• **DermaHerb:** Though it suggests a product for dermatological conditions, it is not the cream developed by CSIR-CIMAP.
 
• **SkinCure:** This name implies a skin treatment product but is unrelated to the specific development of PsoriaCIM.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **PsoriaCIM’s Development Process:**

 
 
• The product was developed after rigorous **scientific research and clinical trials** conducted by CSIR-CIMAP.
 
• It incorporates **herbal ingredients** known for their anti-inflammatory and skin-soothing properties.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Herbal Medicine:**
 
 
• Herbal medicine is gaining popularity due to its **minimal side effects**, cost-effectiveness, and natural origins.
 
• India has a rich tradition of using herbs for therapeutic purposes, stemming from ancient systems like **Ayurveda**.
